topic: How do distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configuration trade-offs between coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation?
consensus_response: Distributed satellite constellations impact orbital configurations by trading off coverage and inter-satellite interference mitigation. Protocols like LDMA, CDMA, and TDMA/CDMA balance efficiency and scalability, while beamforming reduces interference. Adaptive beamforming optimizes performance dynamically, but introduces complexity.
reference_context: SatCom systems face trade-offs between coverage and interference, with protocols and beamforming techniques mitigating issues.
